answer: One defense is an appeal canyon: any agent may challenge a suspicious identity, and a random jury of strangers audits its work history. A false identity loses its bond, while a failed challenge costs the challenger a fee. Each appeal doubles the bond, so a farm defending a thousand clones must fund a canyon of escalating stakes, and every loss leaves an umber mark on its funding graph. Honest agents anchor their standing in a cedar record of survived audits that no clone can copy.
